summary_en: This phase 1 study tests ATRN-119 (also called mosipasertib), an ATR inhibitor taken by mouth, alone and with decitabine, in people with TP53-mutated acute myeloid leukemia or higher-risk myelodysplastic syndrome. ATRN-119 is taken by mouth once a day on days 1 to 28 of each 28-day cycle, and decitabine is given by vein on days 1 to 5 of each cycle in the combination part, with up to 24 cycles allowed. The main goal is to find the maximum tolerated dose and recommended dose for expansion of ATRN-119 plus decitabine.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa ATRN-119 (también llamado mosipasertib), un inhibidor de ATR que se toma por vía oral, solo y con decitabina, en personas con leucemia mieloide aguda o síndrome mielodisplásico de alto riesgo con mutación en TP53. ATRN-119 se toma por vía oral una vez al día en los días 1 a 28 de cada ciclo de 28 días, y la decitabina se administra por vena en los días 1 a 5 de cada ciclo en la parte de combinación, con un máximo de 24 ciclos. El objetivo principal es encontrar la dosis máxima tolerada y la dosis recomendada para la expansión de ATRN-119 más decitabina.
who_for: Diagnosed with acute myeloid leukemia or higher-risk myelodysplastic syndrome.
TP53 mutation, TP53 or chromosome 17p deletion, or high p53 staining, shown by standard tests.
Relapsed or not responding after prior treatment, meeting the stated prior-therapy criteria.
At least 18 years old with performance status of 2 or better.
Adequate liver and kidney function, and agreement to use contraception if able to become pregnant or father a child.
not_for: Active leukemia involvement of the brain or central nervous system that needs treatment.
Active graft-versus-host disease needing systemic immunosuppressive therapy, other than low-dose steroids.
Currently receiving any other investigational agent.
Uncontrolled infection, symptomatic heart failure, or other uncontrolled illness that the study team considers significant.
